scientific_integrity: Exact equations and incidence proof are supplied; external independent audit not performed. Published existence is distinguished from the new converse.
scientific_limitations: Complex projective/unlabeled classification only, for one conic and six lines with A1/A3/D4 singularities. Representative existence and Jacobian near freeness are credited to the earlier exact construction; no new syzygy-rank computation is claimed. Other degree-eight splits and degree-nine cases are open here. Possible unindexed earlier equivalent uniqueness remains a priority risk.
title: Projective rigidity of the nearly free conic–six-line octic
